放慢节奏——当晨雾中的渔火与暮色里的船歌成为记忆坐标时，乌江的魂便悄然入心。: Slow down — when the morning mist's fishing lights and the evening boat songs become your memory landmarks, the soul of the Wu River quietly finds its way into your heart.
九寨溝是一條被森林所覆蓋的山溝，因有九個藏族村寨坐落在這片高山湖泊群中而得名。世: Jiuzhaigou is a forested mountain valley named for the nine Tibetan villages nestled among its alpine lake clusters. A World Natural Heritage site and National AAAAA Scenic Area, Jiuzhaigou is celebrated for its "Six Wonders" — alpine lake clusters, waterfalls, colorful forests, snow-capped peaks, blue ice, and Tibetan culture — earning it the title "King of Waterscapes."
位於張家界國家森林公園的北部，東臨索溪峪景區，因明初土家族領袖向大坤自號「向王天: Located in northern Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Tianzi Mountain was named after a Ming-era Tujia leader. It rises 1,262.5m at its peak with four wonders: sea of clouds, moonlit nights, rosy dawns, and winter snow.
作為世界第八大奇蹟，這裏出土了數以千計與真人等高的陶俑、陶馬，每一尊兵俑的面容神: The 8th wonder of the world — thousands of life-sized terracotta soldiers and horses, each with unique facial features, standing in solemn formation. They vividly recreate the mighty army and royal guard of the Qin Empire from 2,000 years ago.
南寧，一座將自然風光、歷史底蘊與市井煙火完美融合的城市。這裏既有青山的秀美與江水: Nanning seamlessly blends natural beauty, deep history, and vibrant local life. Here, verdant hills and graceful rivers meet timeworn lanes and bustling night markets.
南寧天氣溼熱，防曬 + 雨傘必備。: Nanning is hot and humid, so sun protection + an umbrella are essential.
南寧以其包容的姿態，將山水之秀、歷史之厚與生活之趣編織在一起，等待旅行者前來細細: With an open, welcoming spirit, Nanning weaves together beautiful landscapes, rich history, and the pleasures of everyday life, inviting travelers to savor them at leisure.
大雁塔本身是方形樓閣式磚塔，古樸莊重，內藏貝葉經等珍貴佛教文物，登塔可俯瞰南郊全: Big Wild Goose Pagoda is a square brick pagoda housing rare Buddhist relics. Climb for panoramic southern views. The north square hosts Asia's largest musical fountain; the south square is perfect for photos. The whole area blends ancient charm with lively leisure.
天壇是明清兩代皇帝「祭天」「祈穀」的場所，是中國現存最大的古代祭祀性建築群。世界: The Temple of Heaven was where Ming and Qing emperors offered sacrifices for good harvests — the largest ancient sacrificial complex in China. A UNESCO site featuring the Hall of Prayer, Echo Wall, and Circular Mound Altar. Visit in the morning to see locals exercising.
天安門廣場位於北京城市中軸線上，是世界上最大的城市廣場，國家象徵和政治活動的重要: Tiananmen Square — the world's largest city square, located on Beijing's central axis. The Monument to the People's Heroes stands at its center, with Tiananmen Tower to the north. Daily flag-raising ceremonies draw crowds who wait through the night.
洪崖洞集巴渝文化、魔幻景觀、市井煙火於一體，合理規劃可避開人流高峯，深度體驗山城: Hongyadong blends Bayu culture, magical scenery and everyday local life. Plan wisely to skip the crowds and soak up the full charm of this mountain city.
其魅力不止於一碗鮮香熱辣的螺螄粉，更在於江流曲似九迴腸的百里柳江風光、滿城綻放的: Its charm goes beyond a bowl of spicy luosifen — it's the winding Liujiang River, spring bauhinia blossoms, deep history, and rich ethnic culture.
初次到訪可優先雙橋溝觀光線路，體力友好且景觀密度高；重度徒步玩家再安排長坪溝深度: First-time visitors should start with the easy-to-walk Shuangqiao Valley sightseeing route, which packs plenty of scenery in for moderate effort. Serious trekkers can then add a deeper route into Changping Valley.
位於麗江古城西北，依山傍水，比大研古鎮幽靜古樸。古鎮後山是玉龍雪山的余脈，山巒青: Shuhe Ancient Town lies northwest of Lijiang, nestled by mountains and water — quieter than Dayan. Backed by the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain foothills, it features well-preserved stone bridges and temples. Part of the Lijiang UNESCO World Heritage site.
茶馬古道上最著名的城鎮之一，已有八九百年歷史。古城內木樓青瓦，古街石巷，小橋流水: One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road with 800-900 years of history. Wooden buildings with grey tiles, stone lanes, bridges over streams — look up from East Street and see Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. One of two ancient towns in China successfully inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage sites in their entirety.
荔波小七孔是一片以七孔古橋為核心的喀斯特地貌奇觀，因清代一座七孔石橋橫跨響水河而: Libo Xiaoqikong is a karst wonder centered on an ancient seven-arch bridge, named after a Qing-dynasty stone bridge spanning the Xiangshui River. It is a national AAAAA-rated tourist attraction and a key part of the 「South China Karst」 World Natural Heritage Site. Its emerald waters and secluded pools, tiered cascades, water forest, limestone caves and underground rivers, and Buyi culture are collectively known as the 「Five Charms of Xiaoqikong」, earning it the title 「Emerald on the Earth's Belt」.
黃果樹瀑布是中國最大、世界知名的大瀑布，因當地廣泛分佈的黃葛榕而得名。國家AAA: Huangguoshu Waterfall is China's largest waterfall and one of the world's most famous, named after the Chinese banyan trees widespread in the area. It is a national AAAAA-rated tourist attraction and appears on the tentative list for World Natural Heritage status. Its mighty flow, six-direction viewing spectacle, shifting scenes inside and outside Water Curtain Cave, and karst gorge scenery are known collectively as the 「Four Wonders of Huangguoshu」, earning it the title 「China's Premier Waterfall」.
赤水丹霞是中國面積最大的丹霞地貌區之一，因赤紅砂岩與翠竹飛瀑交相輝映而得名。世界: Chishui Danxia is one of China's largest Danxia landform areas — named for its red sandstone cliffs contrasting with green bamboo and waterfalls. Part of the UNESCO China Danxia site. Known for Danxia cliffs, waterfalls, bamboo forests, cycad fossils, and red culture.
集山、水、洞於一身的張家界地貌的博物館，在此可觀賞到北溫帶喀斯特地形的全部風景。: A natural museum of Zhangjiajie's landscape in miniature — mountains, water, and caves all in one place — where visitors can admire the full sweep of northern-temperate karst scenery in a single trip. The canyon is thick with lush vegetation and fresh air, with cascading waterfalls and bubbling streams around nearly every turn — a true natural oxygen bar. Beyond the breathtaking scenery, the park's must-try highlight is the world's tallest and longest glass bridge. Standing on the Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon Glass Bridge, you gaze straight down at the canyon floor 400 meters below.
熱爾大草原是僅次於呼倫貝爾草原的中國第二大草原，著名的天然濕地花湖就在熱爾大草原: Re'er Grassland is China's second-largest grassland, second only to the Hulunbuir Grassland, and is home to the famous natural wetland Flower Lake. The grassland is dotted with lakes and grazed by cattle and sheep; along the way, Tibetan-style homestays run by herdsmen offer food and horse-riding. The best time to visit is July and August in summer, when the hillsides burst into bloom with wildflowers.
故宮是明清兩代的皇家宮殿，又稱紫禁城，是世界現存規模最大、保存最完整的木質結構古: The Forbidden City — the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties — is the world's largest and best-preserved ancient wooden architectural complex. A UNESCO World Heritage site housing over a million cultural relics. Stroll along the central axis from the Meridian Gate to the Gate of Divine Prowess and feel the weight of 600 years of history.
頤和園是清朝乾隆、光緒年間營建的皇家行宮御苑，以昆明湖、萬壽山為基址，汲取江南園: The Summer Palace — built during the Qianlong and Guangxu reigns — is China's largest and best-preserved imperial garden, centered on Kunming Lake and Longevity Hill with Jiangnan-style landscaping. A UNESCO site featuring the Tower of Buddhist Incense, the Long Corridor, and the Seventeen-Arch Bridge.
這座國家級博物館擁有37萬餘件藏品，從史前陶器、商周青銅重器，到漢代瓦當、唐代金: This national museum houses 370,000+ artifacts spanning from prehistoric pottery to Shang-Zhou bronzes, Han tiles, Tang gold and silverware, and murals. The agate cup with gold animal head and the silver pot with dancing horse are world-famous national treasures. Walking through the time-ordered halls is like reading a three-dimensional history of ancient China.
這座環繞古城中心的明代城牆，全長約13.7公里，牆頂寬闊平坦，可以步行、騎行或乘: This Ming Dynasty city wall encircles the ancient center for 13.7km — its broad top is perfect for walking, cycling, or taking an electric car. Battlements, watchtowers, and barbicans remain well-preserved. Standing on the wall, you see ancient streets inside and modern skyscrapers outside — a striking contrast of past and present.
這座邊城不靠大廣場和商圈熱鬧，也不靠網紅打卡的噱頭，真正抓住人的，是山水裡天然的: This border city does not rely on grand plazas, bustling shopping districts, or trendy photo-stop gimmicks. What truly captures the heart is the natural stillness of its mountains and waters. The scenery waiting around each corner feels like secret savings tucked in your pocket—reassuring, dependable, and entirely your own.
門票免費但需提前數日在「陝西歷史博物館」官方公眾號實名預約，憑身份證入館；館內文: Free entry but requires real-name reservation days in advance via the official Shaanxi History Museum WeChat account. ID required for entry. The densely packed exhibits merit an audio guide or tour guide — otherwise easy to skim. Allow at least 2.5 hours.
在這裏，你可以感受到大自然的獨特魅力。無論是德天跨國大瀑布的壯觀景象，還是明仕田: Here, you can experience nature's distinctive allure. Whether it is the spectacular Detian Transnational Waterfall or the serene beauty of the Mingshi countryside, each will make you want to linger. Every landscape has a character of its own, filling your journey with wonder and moving moments.
德天的水霧、明仕的稻田、花山的巖畫，都是崇左寫給世界的詩。: Detian's drifting spray, Mingshi's rice fields, and Huashan's rock paintings are all verses Chongzuo has written for the world.
銀灘如星河傾灑，潿洲島演繹海與火山的千年戀歌，老街煙火與海上日出交織成最治癒的浪: Silver Beach shimmers like a river of stars, Weizhou Island tells a thousand-year love story between sea and volcano, and the lively old street intertwines with sunrise over the water to create the most soothing romance.
柳候公園，與風共舞，登山賞綠，盡享自然之美。: At Liuhou Park, dance with the breeze, climb among the greenery, and savor nature's beauty to the fullest.
柳州工业博物馆，探寻岁月痕迹，感悟时光流转。: At the Liuzhou Industrial Museum, trace the marks of years gone by and reflect on the passage of time.
夏季是赤水大瀑布和佛光岩的最佳觀賞期，建議穿防滑涼鞋以便親水體驗，三大景段間距離: Summer is the best season for Chishui Waterfall and Foguang Rock — wear non-slip sandals for water access. The three scenic sections are far apart, so driving or chartering is best. Reserve a full day.
潿洲島船票提前15天搶，銀灘日出6點人最少。: Snap up Weizhou Island ferry tickets 15 days in advance; Silver Beach is quietest for sunrise at 6 a.m.
推薦入住湖畔客棧，清晨看湖面薄霧、傍晚看落日，是瀘沽湖最具氛圍的兩個時段。: Stay at a lakeside inn — morning mist on the lake and evening sunset are Lugu Lake's most atmospheric moments.
推薦將索道、玻璃棧道與天門洞連線安排，拍照時段以上午或傍晚為佳，雲霧與山體層次更: Plan a combined route linking the cable car, the glass skywalk, and Tianmen Cave — and aim your photo stops for morning or late afternoon, when drifting mist adds beautiful depth to the mountains.
建議按「步行觀洞 + 暗河乘船」順序體驗，整體節奏更舒適，也能更完整感受溶洞燈光: Experience in this order: walk through the cave first, then take the underground river boat — a more comfortable pace that lets you fully appreciate the cave lighting and karst details.
建議搭配黃河九曲第一灣一同遊覽，傍晚光線與草原天際線非常出片，適合安排日落時段拍: Pair this stop with the First Bend of the Yellow River's Nine Curves — the evening light against the grassland horizon is incredibly photogenic, so time your visit for sunset.
春梯疊翠，夏夜流螢；秋收金浪，冬火映樓: Spring terraces gleam green, summer nights glow with fireflies, autumn harvests ripple in gold, winter fires reflect on towers.
春湍夏瀑，水霧生煙；秋清冬凝，別樣洞天: Spring torrents and summer cascades rise in mist; autumn runs clear and winter freezes into an otherworldly realm
春潭凝翠，夏林探幽；秋霧鎖橋，冬水如鏡: Spring pools glow emerald and summer forests invite exploration; autumn mist veils the bridge and winter waters mirror the sky
春竹滴翠，夏瀑生涼；秋林盡染，冬霧迷蒙: Spring bamboo drips emerald, summer waterfalls bring coolness; autumn forests blaze with color, winter mist veils everything.
春雲漫卷，夏翠欲滴；秋高氣爽，冬雪披紗: Spring clouds billow, summer greenery glistens; autumn skies soar crisp and clear, while winter snow drapes the mountain in gauze
春秋兩季天氣最穩定，雲海出現概率高，登紅雲金頂需手腳並用攀援鐵索，務必穿防滑鞋並: Spring and autumn have the most stable weather with high probability of sea of clouds. Climbing Red Cloud Golden Summit requires using chain handrails — wear non-slip shoes and check weather alerts. Tickets must be reserved in advance on the official platform.
傍晚時分登城最佳，可同時欣賞落日餘暉與城市燈火；城牆騎行非常受歡迎，但路面為磚石: Best to ascend at dusk to enjoy both sunset glow and city lights. Cycling on the wall is popular but the brick surface is uneven — be careful. The South Gate (Yongning Gate) section has the most brilliant night views.
傍晚時分登觀景台可同時捕捉日落餘暉與燈火初上的交接瞬間，建議住一晚深度體驗苗家生: Ascend the viewing platform at dusk to capture the magical moment when sunset glow meets the first evening lights. We recommend staying overnight for an immersive Miao village experience—morning mists swirling through the village creates an even more serene atmosphere than the night scenery.
建議晚上19:30之後前往，燈光完全點亮後才進入最佳觀賞狀態；想與不倒翁小姐姐互: Go after 19:30 when the lights are fully on for the best experience. To interact and take photos with the roly-poly performers, check the schedule on the official platform and queue up. Weekends are extremely crowded — mind your belongings.
建議環海騎行或包車慢遊，將雙廊、喜洲、才村串聯，一天即可體驗湖景、人文與在地美食: Cycle around Erhai or take a leisurely charter to connect Shuanglang, Xizhou, and Caicun — experience lake views, local culture, and regional cuisine all in one day.
必遊景點：漓江、象鼻山、陽朔西街、龍脊梯田以及兩江四湖。: Must-see attractions: the Li River, Elephant Trunk Hill, Yangshuo West Street, the Longji Rice Terraces, and the Two Rivers and Four Lakes.
高海拔區域建議按景區提示逐步適應，並搭配藍月谷等低海拔景點，行程舒適度更高。: At high altitudes, acclimatize gradually following park guidance. Pair with lower-altitude spots like Blue Moon Valley for a more comfortable itinerary.
江面温差较大，需备防风外套；雨季关注景区实时通航公告。: Temperatures on the river shift a lot — bring a windproof jacket. During the rainy season, check live navigation notices from the scenic area.
雨季路滑，鞋子要防滑，雨衣比雨傘好用，手要空出來扶欄杆。: Paths are slippery in the rainy season, so wear non-slip shoes. A raincoat is more practical than an umbrella and leaves your hands free to hold the railings.
邊境有管制，拍照避開軍警和哨所，聽工作人員安排不逞能。: The border area is regulated. Avoid photographing military personnel, police, or guard posts, and follow staff instructions rather than taking unnecessary risks.
晴天逆光時段可拍到更通透的海面層次。: On sunny days, shooting against the light reveals more layered, translucent textures of the water surface.
黃龍海拔相對較高，建議放慢節奏並注意補水，晴天中午前後觀彩池色彩效果通常更佳。: Huanglong sits at a relatively high elevation — take it slow, stay hydrated, and aim for around midday on clear days when the colors of the pools are at their most brilliant.
江水如翡翠般碧綠，在煙波浩渺中畫舫尋幽，纔是真正的\"人在畫中游\"。高山深谷、: With jade-green waters and a painted boat drifting into the mist, this is the true "traveling within a painting." High peaks, deep valleys, rapids and gorges, cascading waterfalls, ancient trees and twisted vines — a stunning natural spectacle.
游览古镇时，记得穿一双舒适的鞋子，这样才能在青石板路上轻松行走。: When exploring old towns, wear comfortable shoes so you can stroll the flagstone lanes with ease.
東連臥龍自然保護區，南接四姑娘山風景區；與四姑娘山、臥龍共同構成「大熊貓走廊世界: Bordering the Wolong Nature Reserve to the east and the Mount Siguniang Scenic Area to the south, it joins Mount Siguniang and Wolong to form the "Giant Panda Corridor World Heritage Site." The park is home to 82 natural attractions, scattered like brilliant pearls across its six sub-regions. It is a large eco-tourism destination combining pristine landscape sightseeing, mountaineering expeditions, polar-style exploration, skiing and ice-skating, and leisurely vacations.
中國唯一保護完好的高原濕地，以彩池、雪山、峽谷、森林「四絕」著稱於世。景區內的鈣: China's only well-preserved highland wetland, renowned worldwide for its "Four Wonders" — colorful pools, snow-capped mountains, deep gorges, and ancient forests. The travertine pools shift through a rainbow of hues as the surrounding scenery and angle of sunlight change, earning it the nickname "Fairy Pool on Earth." Huanglong is celebrated for its grand scale, ingenious structure, and vividly colored surface travertine landscape, as well as its rare karst formations known across the world.
有「中國阿爾卑斯山」之稱的高海拔雪山，徒步愛好者的天堂: High-altitude snow peaks known as the "Chinese Alps" — a paradise for hiking enthusiasts
四姑娘山是橫斷山脈東部邊緣邛崍山系的最高峰，由四座連綿不斷的山峰組成，這四座山峰: Mount Siguniang is the highest peak of the Qionglai Range on the eastern edge of the Hengduan Mountains, made up of four continuous snow-capped summits that stand like four maidens draped in white veils, rising one after another above the two silver rivers of Changping Valley and Haizi Valley. It has long been a hiker's paradise — the gorge trails are rugged and narrow, with meltwater from the snow peaks trickling gently down in streams; over the ridges lie broad alpine meadows carpeted in wildflowers, painting scenes of gentle, exquisite beauty.
張家界的核心景區為武陵源風景名勝區，一般說到張家界旅遊主要是遊武陵源。武陵源風景: The core scenic area of Zhangjiajie is the Wulingyuan Scenic Area — when people talk about traveling to Zhangjiajie, they usually mean Wulingyuan. Wulingyuan Scenic Area is made up of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Tianzi Mountain Nature Reserve, Suoxiyu Nature Reserve, and Yangjiajie Nature Reserve. Other famous city attractions include Tianmen Mountain National Forest Park, where the heart-stopping glass skywalks and the magical, dreamlike Tianmen Cave are always visitor favorites, hailed as the "new legend of Zhangjiajie". Not far from the city, the "Best Cave Mansion in China" — Huanglong Cave — and the "Fairy Pool on Earth" Baofeng Lake can be reached by bus or taxi. On the city's edge, the "Hundred-Li Gallery" Maoyan River rafting, Sangzhi County's "Asia's No. 1 Cave" Jiutian Cave, Furong Town, and the "World's No. 1 Rafting" Mengdong River rafting are all wonderful places for sightseeing.
中國第一個國家森林公園，是「縮小的仙境，擴大的盆景」: China's first national forest park — a "miniature fairyland and an enlarged bonsai"
分為黃石寨、琵琶溪、金鞭溪、鷂子寨、畬刀溝、袁家界等景區，是遊玩張家界不可不去的: Divided into sub-areas including Huangshizhai, Pipaxi, Jinbianxi, Yaozizhai, Shudaogou, and Yuanjiajie, it is the essential core of any Zhangjiajie trip. Geologically in the youthful stage of peak-forest evolution, the landforms are strikingly unusual: stone pillars stand densely packed in endlessly varied forms, vegetation is lush, the slopes are steep, the ravines are deep, and the climate is warm and humid. Huangshizhai is the most celebrated section inside Zhangjiajie National Forest Park — there is a saying that goes "You haven't truly visited Zhangjiajie unless you've been to Huangshizhai."
天門山因自然奇觀「天門洞」而得名。遊覽天門山時，可以在纜車中俯瞰腳山中美景。核心: Tianmen Mountain takes its name from the natural wonder "Heaven's Gate Cave." As you ride the cable car up, the scenery of the mountain below unfolds beneath your feet. The centerpiece is Tianmen Mountain Temple. The glass skywalks, built along sheer cliffs, are an absolute must — gazing down into the sheer, bottomless valleys while walking through the air delivers a thrilling, once-in-a-lifetime rush. Tianmen Mountain offers three classic sightseeing routes, each with its own iconic highlights.
位於張家界國家森林公園的北部，東臨索溪峪景區，因明初土家族領袖向大坤自號「向王天: Located in the north of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park and bordered by the Suoxiyu scenic area to the east, Tianzi Mountain takes its name from the early-Ming Tujia leader Xiang Dakun, who styled himself "King Xiang, Son of Heaven." Its highest point reaches about 1,262.5 meters and its lowest about 534 meters, and visitors here can witness the four signature wonders — drifting clouds, moonlit nights, sunset-tinged skies, and winter snow. Hundreds of millions of years ago, Tianzi Mountain lay beneath a vast ocean; through long and complex geological processes it rose into the strange and iconic landforms you see today, including the celebrated Yubi (Imperial Brush) Peak.
黃龍洞以高闊的洞天、幽深的暗河、密集的石筍而出名，洞中最高處垂直高度約100多米: Huanglong Cave is famous for its soaring cavern ceilings, deep underground rivers, and dense forest of stalagmites. The cave rises to over 100 meters at its highest point — and the entire cave system contains caves within caves and rivers running through it. Its signature sight is the "Dinghai Shenzhen" (Pillar that Calms the Seas), a stalagmite that has been growing for 200,000 years and rises 20 meters tall — yet only 10 centimeters wide at its narrowest — so valuable that the park has insured it for 100 million yuan. The cave offers both a walking route and a boat ride, so visitors can explore it on land and water.
建議按「步行觀洞 + 暗河乘船」順序體驗，整體節奏更舒適，也能更完整感受溶洞燈光: For the most comfortable pace — and the best chance to take in the cave lighting and karst details — do the walking portion first, then the underground-river boat ride.
玻璃橋建議提前預約時段，並預留充足排隊與步行時間；若偏好拍照，可選非高峰時段上橋: Book a glass-bridge time slot in advance and leave plenty of time for queuing and walking. Photographers will enjoy the bridge most during off-peak hours.

The Li River is the soul and essence of Guangxi — its clear waters weaving through the blue-green karst peak forests, unfolding into a living landscape painting.
北海，一個被許多人忽視的旅遊勝地，卻足以讓人“待着就不想走”。它的魅力不在於“驚: Beihai is a travel gem many people overlook, yet once there, you may “never want to leave.” Its charm lies not in being “dazzling,” but in feeling “comfortable”—a place where body and mind unwind and life returns to its simple, authentic rhythm.
其魅力不止於一碗鮮香熱辣的螺螄粉，更在於“江流曲似九迴腸”的百里柳江風光、滿城綻: Its appeal reaches far beyond a bowl of fragrant, spicy luosifen. It also lies in the sweeping Liu River scenery, where “the winding water twists like nine coils,” the citywide bloom of spring bauhinias, and a deep historical legacy enriched by vibrant ethnic traditions.
這裏山清水秀，景色宜人，被譽爲“世界第一大盆景”。在這裏，能感受民族風情的濃郁氣: With clear waters, green hills, and delightful scenery, this place is praised as “the world's largest natural bonsai.” Here, you can immerse yourself in vibrant ethnic traditions, taste authentic local food, admire the landscapes, and encounter beauty when you least expect it.

江水如翡翠般碧綠，在煙波浩渺中畫舫尋幽，纔是真正的“人在畫中游”。高山深谷、峽灩: With emerald-green waters and a painted boat drifting through misty waves, you truly feel "in the painting." Towering peaks, deep valleys, plunging waterfalls, ancient trees and vines weave a breathtaking landscape.
東連臥龍自然保護區，南接四姑娘山風景區；與四姑娘山、臥龍共同構成「大熊貓走廊世界: To the east lies Wolong Nature Reserve, to the south Mount Siguniang — together they form the UNESCO "Giant Panda Corridor World Heritage Site." The park has 82 natural attractions, like shining pearls.
“桂林山水甲天下，陽朔山水甲桂林”是對這片土地最精準的概括。漓江是廣西的精華與靈: The saying "Guilin's scenery tops the world, Yangshuo's scenery tops Guilin" captures it best. The Li River is Guangxi's essence and soul — clear waters winding through ink-blue karst peaks.
梵淨山是武陵山脈主峰，因「梵天淨土」的佛教寓意而得名。世界自然遺產，國家AAAA: Mount Fanjing is the main peak of the Wuling Mountains, named for its Buddhist meaning of 'Pure Land in the Brahma Heaven.' A World Natural Heritage site and national AAAAA-level tourist attraction, it's one of China's five major Buddhist mountains. Renowned as the 'City in the Sky,' it boasts four wonders: the precipitous Red Cloud Golden Summit, the bizarre Mushroom Rock, the ethereal Sea of Clouds and Buddha's Light, and the rare Guizhou snub-nosed monkeys.
西江千戶苗寨是全世界最大的苗族聚居村寨，因上千座吊腳樓層層疊疊分佈於兩座山巒之上: Xijiang Qianhu Miao Village is the largest Miao settlement in the world, named for its thousands of stilted houses layered across two mountainsides. A national AAAA-level tourist attraction and historical cultural town, it's celebrated as 'China's Miao Capital' for five signature experiences: the night view of countless twinkling lights, Miao stilted architecture, the 'mountains and flowing water' toast ceremony, silver ornament craftsmanship, and ancient Miao 'Flying Songs'.
大理「風花雪月」四大名景之一，外形如同耳朵，是由西洱河塌陷形成的高原湖泊。共有三: One of Dali's four famous 'Wind, Flowers, Snow, Moon' scenery spots, Erhai Lake is ear-shaped, formed by the collapse of the Western Erhai River. Known as the 'Flawless Jade Among Mountains,' it features three islands, four islets, five lakes, and nine winding bends with crystal-clear waters. Popular lakeside villages include Shuanglang with its 'Divine Light of Erhai,' Caicun where the film 'Blueless' was shot, and Xizhou, renowned for its Bai ethnic architecture.
瀘沽湖為川滇兩省界湖，湖周邊主要居住著摩梭人、彜族和普米族。湖水清澈蔚藍，是雲南: Straddling Sichuan and Yunnan provinces, Lugu Lake is home to the Mosuo, Yi and Pumi peoples. Its clear blue waters make it Yunnan's highest-altitude lake and one of China's deepest freshwater lakes, shrouded in mystery. Surrounded by towering mountains with snow cover for over three months each year and rich forest resources, it is dubbed a "fairyland on earth." Highlights include the Goddess Cable Car, Small Grassland Sea and the Three Islands of Lugu — electric buggy lake tours are the most popular way to explore.
八達嶺長城是明長城中保存最完好、最具代表性的一段，也是萬里長城最早向遊人開放的地: The Badaling section is the best-preserved and most iconic portion of the Ming Great Wall, and the first to open to visitors — hailed as one of the Nine Great Passes of China. A World Heritage Site and national 5A scenic area, it features steep terrain, towering walls, and densely placed watchtowers with distinct scenery across all four seasons. Take the cable car up, then hike to North Four Tower or Hero Peak for sweeping views of the dragon winding through the peaks.
天安門廣場位於北京城市中軸線上，是世界上最大的城市廣場，國家象徵和政治活動的重要: Tiananmen Square lies on Beijing's central axis and is the largest city square in the world, serving as an important national symbol and venue for political activities. At its center stands the Monument to the People's Heroes, the solemn Tiananmen gate tower rises at the northern end, the National Museum of China is on the east side, and the Great Hall of the People is on the west. The daily flag-raising ceremony is solemn and dignified, drawing countless people who wait through the night. You can combine your visit with the National Museum, experiencing the continuity and glory of Chinese civilization between history and the present.
震驚世界的「地下軍陣」和秦代軍事藝術的巔峰之作: A "terracotta army" that stunned the world — the pinnacle of Qin-dynasty military art.
作為世界第八大奇蹟，這裏出土了數以千計與真人等高的陶俑、陶馬，每一尊兵俑的面容神: Recognized as the Eighth Wonder of the World, the site has unearthed thousands of life-sized terracotta warriors and horses, each face uniquely distinct, arranged in formidable formations with overwhelming grandeur, vividly recreating the fierce armies and royal processions of the great Qin Empire more than two thousand years ago. The scale of the pit ruins is colossal and the level of detail breathtaking — an essential destination for anyone seeking to experience the spirit of China's first unified dynasty.
兵馬俑位於臨潼區，距離西安市區約1小時車程，建議單獨留出至少半天時間遊覽；參觀時: The Terracotta Army is located in Lintong District, about a one-hour drive from central Xi'an. It is recommended to set aside at least half a day for this visit. Be sure to follow a guided tour or use an audio guide during your visit — otherwise you risk seeing only the clay figures without grasping the historical context.
噴泉表演每晚固定時間上演，建議提前占位；南廣場周邊的大悅城三樓觀景台是免費拍攝塔: The fountain show runs at a fixed time every evening — arrive early to grab a spot. The free viewing terrace on the 3rd floor of Joy City, by the south square, is the best angle to photograph the pagoda's full silhouette.
這條南北走向的仿唐街區，入夜後金碧輝煌，紅燈籠、唐風建築、巨型雕塑陣列依次鋪開，: Running north to south, this Tang-inspired district becomes a dazzling spectacle after dark, as red lanterns, Tang-style architecture and monumental sculptures unfold one after another—as though the world of The Longest Day in Chang’an had been brought to life. Free street performances include the roly-poly dancer, a levitating Terracotta Warrior and Li Bai poetry challenges, while shops on both sides sell Tang-style hanfu, creative cultural gifts and intangible-heritage snacks. Whether you come to watch, take photographs or immerse yourself in a journey back through time, the experience is immensely rewarding.
彩雲之南，這裏有希爾頓書中的香巴拉，有洛克眼中的世外桃源，有藏族人心中神聖的梅裏: South of the Colorful Clouds—Yunnan hides Shangri-La from Hilton's pages, the paradise James Hilton described, and the sacred Meili Snow Mountain revered by Tibetans. Flowers bloom year-round here as mountains, lakes, flower seas, snow-capped peaks, and terraced fields compose breathtaking landscapes. Kunming, the provincial capital, enjoys springlike weather year-round. Lijiang, an ancient town rich in natural beauty, is home to the Naxi people. Dali, birthplace of Yunnan's earliest culture, boasts four famous scenes: 'Wind, Flowers, Snow, Moon.' Xishuangbanna offers tropical charm as the homeland of peacocks and elephants. Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture (Shangri-La) is both a pilgrimage site and paradise for hikers.
赤水丹霞是中國面積最大的丹霞地貌區之一，因赤紅砂岩與翠竹飛瀑交相輝映而得名。世界: Chishui Danxia is one of China's largest Danxia landform areas, named for the striking contrast between crimson sandstone cliffs and verdant bamboo groves with cascading waterfalls. Part of the World Natural Heritage 'China Danxia,' this AAAAA-level scenic area is called the 'Crown of Danxia, City of Thousand Waterfalls' for five magnificent features: Danxia cliffs, waterfall clusters, bamboo sea forests, ancient cycad relics, and revolutionary red culture.
